recovery.riskNotes: CRITICAL: finalizeRecovery replaces ALL Safe owners via execTransactionFromModule (ownership takeover primitive); confirmRecovery/multiConfirmRecovery/executeRecovery collect guardian signatures (EIP-712 + SignatureChecker incl. ERC-1271). CRITICAL: GuardianStorage guardian-set/threshold state is the authorization root; onlyWhenModuleIsEnabled gates writes. HIGH: nonce/confirmation lifecycle (confirmedHashes, walletsNonces, invalidateNonce), recovery replacement rule, recoveryPeriod timelock.

staking.riskNotes: CRITICAL: stake/_initiateWithdrawal/initiateWithdrawal/initiateWithdrawalAtPosition/claimWithdrawal move SAFE tokens; withdrawal queue is a per-staker doubly linked list with caller-supplied insertion positions. CRITICAL: recoverTokens moves tokens (owner-only). HIGH: proposeValidators/executeValidatorChanges/proposeWithdrawDelay/executeWithdrawDelayChange mutate validator set and delays under timelock; execute* are public and hash-bound.

notes: Staking.sol imports only OpenZeppelin; no dependency on Consensus/FROST code (out of scope, context-only).
SocialRecoveryModule inherits GuardianStorage directly (Ackee M1 fix present in pinned code); no separate storage contract.
Both targets are small; full-file reads fit one chunk each. No file exceeds the token budget.
strategy: single-pass, two domains in risk order. Domain A (Staking.sol) first: unaudited-by-docs-page contract, fund movement + linked-list queue + timelocked admin. Domain B (Social Recovery) second: formally verified + Ackee-audited, hunt for variants/neighbors of excluded issues and uncovered paths only. Hunter per domain in parallel; single Skeptic then single Referee over merged findings; serialized Foundry POC verification.
